drhp.business: Sheetal Universal Limited is engaged in manufacturing of agricultural products, operating in a single business segment ("Manufacturing of Agricultural Products") with its major business activity in India. During the year it expanded its product portfolio by launching a new line of flavoured nuts, in addition to its existing range of nuts.
drhp.expansion: The Company expanded its product portfolio during the year by launching a new line of flavoured nuts, in addition to its existing range of nuts. It has also initiated steps to expand its international presence through the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary, Helios Global LLC, in Russia on 5 March 2026, for import and wholesale trading of food products; as of 31 March 2026 the subsidiary had not commenced operations. The Company intends to expand its operations and increase its share in domestic and international markets.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
